note: The State Bank of Pakistan's press release of 9 April 2021: from July 2021, defaults and delayed payments show on a consumer's eCIB report for two years. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported (the eCIB master circular answers with a Cloudflare check, not passed), so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: State Bank of Pakistan, Reflection of two years history in borrowers’ eCIB reports (9 April 2021)
sources.said: However, defaults, delayed payments, etc. after 1st July 2021 will be shown on the credit reports for two years.
